reuse_boundary: A symmetric mount is not automatically a defect. Object required an asymmetric registration datum because its source-owned module had an orientation-disambiguation need. This Building panel currently has no source-owned physical key requirement, so the reversible pattern is retained rather than copied from Object by analogy.
truth_boundary: This contract proves only that the exact current four-point Building panel mount pattern and current box proof geometry are compatible with an in-plane 180-degree reversal at both existing receiver frames while preserving the original source identities and receiver-frame metadata. It does not prove that a production panel should be reversible, that future controls/text/hinges/connectors are orientation-neutral, or any fastener, seal, load, manufacturing, runtime, gameplay, visual, CANON or production-readiness claim.
